name: ai-found-management
description: 遺失物（落し物）管理アプリケーション — Elysia API + Next.js on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "bun run cf-dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web cf:build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:api && bun run deploy:web
